verdict.rationale: Unleash documents an official MCP server that lets LLM-powered coding assistants create and manage feature flags, and debug why a user does or doesn't get a flag. This makes natural-language operation possible, but only through an external AI assistant acting as the client; there is no evidence of a built-in natural-language interface in the Admin UI. Missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command interface, documented breadth of NL-operable actions beyond flag creation/management, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: This server enables LLM-powered coding assistants to create and manage feature flags following Unleash best practices.
Check why a user gets or doesn't get a flag.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.getunleash.io/integrate/mcp
